probes.name: inplace
probes.source:
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim n As Name,s As String,ws As Worksheet
Set ws=ActiveSheet
s="sheet=" & ws.Name & ";filter=" & CStr(ws.FilterMode) & ";hidden=" & CStr(ws.Rows(2).Hidden) & "," & CStr(ws.Rows(3).Hidden) & ";names=["
For Each n In ActiveWorkbook.Names
s=s & n.Name & ":" & n.RefersTo & ":" & CStr(n.Visible) & "|"
Next
Snapshot=s & "];area=" & ws.PageSetup.PrintArea & ";titles=" & ws.PageSetup.PrintTitleRows & "," & ws.PageSetup.PrintTitleColumns
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,v As Variant,s As String
Set ws=ActiveSheet
ws.Name="Data"
ws.Range("A1:B1").Value=Array("Name","Qty")
ws.Range("A2:B2").Value=Array("apple",1)
ws.Range("A3:B3").Value=Array("pear",2)
ws.Range("D1:E1").Value=Array("Name","Qty")
ws.Range("G1:G2").Value=Application.Transpose(Array("Name","a*"))
ws.PageSetup.PrintArea="A1:B3"
ws.PageSetup.PrintTitleRows="$1:$1"
ws.PageSetup.PrintTitleColumns="$A:$A"
v=ws.Range("A1:B3").AdvancedFilter(1,ws.Range("G1:G2"))
s="before=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
ws.Name="O'Brien renamed"
Probe=s & ";after=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
End Function
